situation: Converting MCP tool definitions for different GLM endpoints.
decision: Use a central tool registry that converts MCP tools/list into each provider-specific function format, with canonical fields: stable tool ID, namespace, JSON schema, required scopes, risk class, cache policy.
reasoning_physics: One canonical registry + model-specific projection avoids maintaining N tool definitions manually and lets risk class / scope / cache policy be enforced once. Deterministic ordering improves prompt-cache hits across endpoints.
